records.text: Owens said Dave Rubin's book falsely stated that Ukraine was a member of NATO.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And even if you go back to Dave Rubin's book, which I read, Don't Burn This Book, I knew he had no idea about foreign policy because there's a chapter where he actually published, I think this was back in 2020 when he published his book, that Ukraine was a member of NATO.

verification.notes: A searchable copy of the 2020 book contains the sentence that Ukraine gave up nuclear weapons to become a NATO country. NATO currently and explicitly states that Ukraine is a partner, not a member. Owens characterization of the published passage as false is therefore confirmed.

sources.relevance: Contains the published passage stating that Ukraine became a NATO country.
